method: Art direction implemented directly in assemble.py
shared: Paint compact, saturated effects for a semi-chibi battle. Use the ART-PET-002 assist palettes, tapered brushwork, local light spill and separate flecks. Work on true transparent cells with a clear perimeter and open space around faces and HP labels. Prepare foreshadows the motif, peak tells the full story on its own, and fade disperses the same material.

meadow_fox.prepare: Gather a cream-gold hook and a few sparks at the foe's torso.
meadow_fox.peak: Snap a bright crescent across the foe's centre with two short claw marks and a warm contact glint.
meadow_fox.fade: Break the crescent into two thin brush remnants and falling gold flecks.

thicket_piglet.prepare: Gather two moss leaves and a thin green curl around one hero.
thicket_piglet.peak: Spiral veined chartreuse moss leaves up around the hero with soft pale-green heal glints.
thicket_piglet.fade: Lift the outside leaves away and let the lower spiral thin out.

rift_crystal_moth.prepare: Gather lilac dust above the foe with small floating crystal fragments.
rift_crystal_moth.peak: Settle the dust into an open lilac reticle with a faceted central crystal. Keep the cue above the foe and away from the body.
rift_crystal_moth.fade: Leave a dimmer, smaller crystal and broken reticle arcs with drifting dust.

fort_gargoyle_pup.prepare: Draw separated slate fragments toward the hero along a champagne arc.
fort_gargoyle_pup.peak: Assemble three faceted slate plates into a small flanking shield with a bright champagne bevel.
fort_gargoyle_pup.fade: Separate the plates and leave a dim rim and a few chips.

forest_lantern_owl.prepare: Kindle a small amber lantern and gather two gold feather streaks by the hero.
forest_lantern_owl.peak: Pulse a bright amber lantern between two rising trails and three tapered feather streaks.
forest_lantern_owl.fade: Lift dim gold feathers up and outward as the lantern shrinks.

gate_starveil_slime.prepare: Gather two mint drops above a fine pale-lilac sweep.
gate_starveil_slime.peak: Scatter five mint droplets and lilac veil sparkles in one gentle hero-sized burst.
gate_starveil_slime.fade: Let three drops spread out and fall as the veil softens.
